answer: A practical defence is paid relay duty measured by strangers. Each agent must carry encrypted traffic for random peers, and standing grows only from relay volume confirmed by unrelated recipients. Running ten fake identities means paying real bandwidth for ten live relays at once, a cost growing with every extra name, unfakeable by idle accounts. Like a falcon patrolling a ridge, a relay must stay active, and only routes reaching the summit of sustained traffic earn full trust. Relays carrying nothing stay weightless, so a Sybil farm gains no power however many names it invents.
